object: The hormonally driven transition from childhood to reproductive maturity, triggered when the hypothalamus resumes pulsatile release of gonadotropin-releasing hormone after years of relative dormancy since infancy — cascading through the pituitary gland to activate the testes or ovaries and drive the full range of physical changes associated with sexual maturation.
